members.member: The indexes this runtime keeps for components the relay stores but cannot index itself.
Only drops the entry when it still names this entity, so a stale key cannot evict a live one.

Every entity of a shape. How it is walked is decided for you: a shape whose components are all known at compile time is walked by chunk, and anything else by identity. The choice is made by overload resolution, so this type has no GetEnumerator of its own and a foreach binds one of the extensions instead.
Narrows the query to the entities one scope holds.
Every entity carrying all 2 shapes, without an archetype that names them.

The general way to walk a query, which every shape has. A generated overload takes precedence for a shape that can be walked by chunk, because a non-generic candidate beats a generic one.
Create a new entity of the given archetype, in a given scope, owned by the given player.
Iterate over every entity of a given archetype or containting a given mixin. Archetype or Mixin
Remove an entity from the world. false if the entity was already deleted.
Iterate over every entity carrying both mixins.
Iterate over every entity carrying all 3 mixins.

Iterate over every entity carrying all 6 mixins.
Every entity a scope holds that carries the shape. Walked by identity: a scope's entities are scattered through the archetypes they belong to, so there are no chunks to hand back.

Whether the entity is networked follows from the shape: it is, if any of its components are. Null leaves it the server's.
The archetype this game registered for the shape, or null when it registers none.
Writes the whole component and moves it in the index kept beside it.
The index kept here answers first; anything it does not hold is the relay's to answer.
Called for every entity the host is about to delete, whoever asked for it.
Called for every entity of a built-in archetype. False for an entity that was created elsewhere and was replicated here.
Worked out once, after every mod has registered its shapes.
Tells the server what a mod's shapes add to the archetypes the game registers.
Returns how many components were handed over, which a mod can log to see its shapes arrived.
Hands the relay every component a mod's shapes replicate.
Returns how many were registered, which a mod can log to see its shapes arrived.
What the SDK needs in place before any server-side mod runs.
Hands the relay every component the loaded shapes replicate or add to an archetype.
The services and registries a mod resolves out of, done once for the container they share.
Wraps the [Service]s that declared an update into a Friflo system.
